title: The LEFT function: the first characters
summary: LEFT returns a number of characters from the start of a text.
intro: `LEFT` takes the first characters of a text, such as the country code in a shipment number. It counts from the first character of the stored text.
args: The text, or a reference to a cell holding text.
How many characters; the default is 1.
examples: The first three characters of the shipment code.
errors: The number of characters is negative.

faq.q: Where does LEFT start in right-to-left text such as Arabic?
faq.a: At the first character of the stored text, which is the first character you read in an Arabic word, even though it is shown on the right.
